Angara|Rommel Angara]] |blank1_name = Political party |blank1_info = {{Color box|{{party color|Laban ng Demokratikong Pilipino}}|border=darkgray}} [[Laban ng Demokratikong Pilipino|LDP]] |blank2_name = Congressional bloc |blank2_info = Majority }} '''Aurora's at-large congressional district''' is the sole [[congressional district of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Aurora (province)|Aurora]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 1987 and earlier in the [[Batasang Pambansa]] from 1984 to 1986.{{cite web |url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 11, 2021 |archive-date=March 16, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170316064243/http://congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |url-status=dead }} Aurora first elected a single representative provincewide [[at-large]] for the [[Regular Batasang Pambansa]] following its creation as a regular province separate from [[Quezon]] in 1978 and the subsequent [[1984 Philippine constitutional plebiscite]] that amended the 1973 constitution and abolished the regional at-large assembly districts.{{cite web|url=https://www.lawphil.net/statutes/bataspam/bp1978/bp_7_1978.html |title=Batas Pambansa Blg. 7 |publisher=Arellano Law Foundation |accessdate=February 11, 2021}}{{cite web|url=https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/1984/02/01/proclamation-no-2332-s-1984/ |title=Proclamation No. 2332, s. 1984 |date=February 1984 |publisher=[[Official Gazette (Philippines)]] |accessdate=February 11, 2020}} Before 1978, the province was represented in the [[List of legislatures of the Philippines|national legislatures]] as part of [[Quezon's 1st congressional district|Quezon's (formerly Tayabas) 1st]] and [[Quezon's at-large congressional district|at-large]] congressional districts. The district was re-created on February 2, 1987 following the ratification of the [[Constitution of the Philippines|1987 constitution]] that restored the House of Representatives.{{cite web|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm |title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines |publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library |accessdate=February 11, 2021}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Rommel T. Angara|Rommel Angara]] of the [[Laban ng Demokratikong Pilipino]] (LDP).{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 11, 2021}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Batasang
